connector.name: Server Ops MCP
connector.registryDescription: Server ops MCP: logs, monitoring, code edit, Nginx & certs. Local + SSH, confirmations & redaction.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package server-ops-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the gt-dinuo account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OPS_CONFIG_PATH
env.description: Path to an extra config file (see config.example.json)
